$comment: The control API's methods and notifications: what `semiont control` serves, over JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line on stdin and stdout. Each method names the schema of its params and of its result; each notification, the schema of its params. packages/codegen/schemas/generate-control.mjs generates the launcher's Go types and Desktop's TypeScript types from this table and the schemas it names, and the schemas themselves for both sides to validate against. protocol/contract/LAUNCHER-CONTROL.md is the contract's prose. `errorData`: the schema of a failed request's error data. `exclusive`: the request waits for every other exclusive request to end, and holds the others off until it does. `sends`: the notifications a request of the method may send besides notifications/progress, which any may.

methods.name: launcher.about
methods.docs: What the launcher is: its version, the API versions it speaks, the runtimes it detects. It reads none of the machine's state.

methods.name: roots.list
methods.docs: Every knowledge base this machine knows: semiont roots.

methods.name: roots.init
methods.docs: Create and register a new local knowledge base: semiont init.

methods.name: roots.forget
methods.docs: Remove one registry row, and no file: semiont forget.

methods.name: status.snapshot
methods.docs: Each knowledge base's stack, and the services they share: semiont status.

methods.name: stack.start
methods.docs: Start a stack, or some of its services: semiont start.

methods.name: stack.stop
methods.docs: Stop a stack, or some of its services: semiont stop.

methods.name: auth.login
methods.docs: Sign in at the issuer a stack's knowledge base trusts, by the device grant, and keep the session in the launcher's store: semiont login. Exclusive while it finds the stack; the wait for the person is not.

methods.name: auth.logout
methods.docs: End the launcher's session for a stack: semiont logout.

methods.name: logs.follow
methods.docs: Follow a stack's service logs until the client cancels or every source ends: semiont logs. Exclusive while it finds the containers; the follow is not.

methods.name: settings.list
methods.docs: Every setting the launcher keeps: semiont settings.

methods.name: settings.set
methods.docs: Set a setting, checked as a start would check it: semiont settings <name> <value>.

methods.name: settings.unset
methods.docs: Return a setting to its default: semiont settings <name> --unset.

methods.name: settings.path
methods.docs: Where a machine document is: semiont settings <document> --path.

notifications.name: notifications/progress
notifications.docs: A line of what a request is doing.

notifications.name: notifications/userAction
notifications.docs: A sign-in waits for a person to enter a code.

notifications.name: notifications/log
notifications.docs: A line a followed service wrote.

notifications.name: notifications/cancelled
notifications.docs: The client gives up on a request.
